name: Redwood Valley
terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

blurb.text: A Mendocino County valley AVA north of Ukiah. It is cooler than the Ukiah Valley, and its grapes ripen and are picked later. In 1949 it held about half of the county's grape acreage.
